scope: Owned loopback server, fresh guest WebKit contexts, tiny same-origin controls and unchanged frozen dist. API is an explicit unavailable 503 fixture; this is not native-backend or static-deployment acceptance.

protocol.nativeWrappers: ENTER ONLY. Reflect.apply original method and return its original result unchanged; no settlement handler attached.
protocol.heldNavigationBoundary: Server has received replacement-document request; response is withheld until old-document calls finish or the bounded cell fails.
protocol.outcomeHandling: Fixture operations catch their own results deliberately; all native pageerror and console-error events remain in ledger.
protocol.privateData: No accounts, credentials, cookies, headers, cache contents, raw trace or query parameters are saved.
